subject.title: [Feature]: Persistent active-agent + workspace indicator in Dashboard (multi-agent safety)

question: Should this issue close once the focused active-agent plus workspace breadcrumb lands, or should closure require the broader live-target proof and optional switch-feedback controls described in the discussion?
rationale: Current main clearly lacks persistent workspace header context and the linked PR covers the focused breadcrumb, but the issue and later comment broaden the safety contract beyond what automation should silently scope up or down.

options.title: Accept focused breadcrumb
options.body: Land or replace the workspace breadcrumb PR and track session-generation, cursor, writable-target, quick-switch, and message-prefix ideas separately.

options.title: Broaden closure bar
options.body: Keep this issue open until an implementation proves the fuller live target tuple and switch feedback in the Dashboard.

options.title: Reject header expansion
options.body: Keep the current agent header, /agent, /status, and workspace rail workflow as the supported path and close the linked PR separately by maintainer decision.

recommendation.title: Accept focused breadcrumb
recommendation.body: Land or replace the workspace breadcrumb PR and track session-generation, cursor, writable-target, quick-switch, and message-prefix ideas separately.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev introduced the active-agent header context that this decision would extend or constrain.
